prompt:
Create a 30-second cinematic anime-style slice-of-life sequence following a young man through a quiet rainy night at home. Begin with a wide atmospheric shot of him standing alone in a dim apartment kitchen beside a large rain-covered window, with glowing city lights visible outside → transition to a warm close-up as he places a pot on the stove and begins preparing a late-night meal → cut to an overhead food close-up as thin noodles cook in bubbling water, surrounded by rising steam → transition to an intimate close-up as he cracks a fresh egg into a small bowl beside the stove → cut to a detailed macro shot of chopsticks lifting freshly cooked noodles from the steaming pot → transition to a cinematic close-up as the noodles are placed into a bowl and topped with a soft-boiled egg, sliced green onions, and red chili seasoning → cut to a warm medium shot as he carefully holds the finished steaming bowl with both hands → transition to a wide nighttime interior shot as he sits alone at a small table beside the rainy window, quietly looking toward the glowing city outside → cut to an extreme food close-up as chopsticks lift the noodles beside the egg and chili topping → transition to an intimate side-profile close-up as he brings the noodles toward his mouth and takes a slow bite → final shots alternate between his peaceful face, the steaming ramen, and the rainy city lights reflected through the window, ending on a quiet wide shot of him sitting alone with his warm meal.

Natural anime cinematography, detailed hand-drawn character animation, cinematic slice-of-life storytelling, realistic food movement, subtle facial expressions, gentle camera motion, smooth cinematic transitions, shallow depth of field, highly detailed ramen textures, rising steam, warm orange kitchen lighting contrasted with cool blue nighttime light, rain-covered glass, colorful city bokeh, atmospheric reflections, soft shadows, detailed apartment interior, intimate framing, peaceful lonely mood, nostalgic nighttime atmosphere, cohesive character appearance throughout every scene. No photorealistic live-action look, no 3D CGI appearance, no distorted faces, unnatural hands, extra fingers, exaggerated expressions, character inconsistency, flickering, subtitles, text, logos, or watermark.

translations.zh:
创作一段30秒的日漫写实生活风格电影感片段，讲述一名年轻男子在雨夜家中度过宁静夜晚的故事。从全景开始：他在昏暗的公寓厨房里独自伫立，身旁是大片被雨水覆盖的窗户，窗外可见微光闪烁的城市夜景 → 切换到温馨特写：他将锅放在炉子上开始准备宵夜 → 俯拍食物特写：细面在翻滚的水中煮熟，升腾起阵阵热气 → 亲近特写：在炉边将一枚新鲜鸡蛋打入小碗 → 宏观特写：筷子从冒着蒸汽的锅中夹起刚煮好的面条 → 电影感特写：面条装入碗中，摆上半熟蛋、葱花和辣椒调味 → 温暖中景：他双手小心端起冒着热气的成品碗 → 室内远景：他独自坐在雨窗旁的小桌前，静静望向外面发光的城市 → 食物微距特写：筷子挑起面条伴着蛋与辣椒配料 → 侧面近景：将面条送入口中细细品尝 → 结尾镜头在他的平静面庞、冒气的拉面和窗户反射的雨夜城市灯火间切换，收尾于他独自享用热食的宁静全景。

自然日漫镜头语言，精细手绘角色动画，治愈系生活叙事，逼真食物动态，细腻微表情，平稳运镜，景深虚化，精致拉面质感，暖橙色厨房光线与冷蓝色雨夜光对比，雨水挂壁玻璃，城市光斑虚化，唯美倒影与柔和阴影。无写实真人感，无3D CGI，无畸变，无闪烁，无文字水印。
